note: KOA Journey at 659 North Street, Houlton; grassy level sites, most facing each other, with catch-and-release ponds on the grounds. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $44.43-79.94 for mid-May 2027 as a 23-ft motorhome; summer runs higher (cheapest $57.75 mid-July). Added 50 amp, sewer, wifi. Not waterfront stands: pond ~1 acre.
flags: GATE: cheapest type a 23-ft motorhome can book is a real Pull Thru, 30 Amps, Water/Electric site (not a pop-up): $44.43 on 5/18/2027, $49.29 on 6/15/2027, $57.75 on 7/13/2027, before tax. Next price up $48.69 (back-in 30A full hookup) in May, $55.60 in June, $62.98 in July. So under $50 through June weeknights, over in July. 10% KOA Rewards not counted, and Good Sam stored false. No gateway within 40 km (Acadia NP 199 km). The stored $44.43 passes only as the season's low. Your call on which night the gate means.

REVIEWS: Google 4.8 from 201 reviews; RV Life 5 stars, 162 ratings, $$$. KOA's own page shows recent praise. Quoted from Google: 'This is a super quiet and well run campground' (3 months ago); 'We have really enjoyed our stay here for the last 3 months' (2 months ago); 'A good portion of the campground are pull throughs with huge grass sites (30 x 100 ft). The drawback is that every 2 sites face each other's door' (9 years ago). RV Life's $$$ on its own would not be a price pass; the engine is.
SEASONAL: KOA lists 'Extended Stays' among ways to stay; I saw no seasonal share stated. Imagery rows look like ordinary pull-throughs with some units parked. Not mostly seasonal on what I read.

WATERFRONT not waterfront stands, though KOA calls one type a 30-amp back-in with 'great views of our pond' and says 'Our park has 3 ponds'. The largest pond on imagery is ~90 x 50 m, about an acre, far below the 5-acre line, and the others are smaller: a pond, no pond-view.
MAX LENGTH: KOA prints "130' Max Length"; I did not store it. Its season is unstated (pool 5/9-10/13 only), so season stays absent.
PIN fine: within the grounds, ~60 m from the centre of the rows.
